lead: Raj Kapoor was a film producer, born on 14 December 1924 in Peshawar.
He died on 2 June 1988 in New Delhi at the age of 63.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Padma Bhushan and Dadasaheb Phalke Award.
This profile collects the Raj facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Raj Kapoor — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Raj Kapoor was born on 14 December 1924 in Peshawar, and holds citizenship of British Raj and India.
Public records name his father, Prithviraj Kapoor and his mother, Ramsarni Kapoor. He is a sibling of Shammi Kapoor and Shashi Kapoor.
He received his education at Colonel Brown Cambridge School and St. Xavier's Collegiate School.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.

sections.heading: Raj Kapoor — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists film producer, film director, screenwriter, film editor and film actor as his occupations.

sections.heading: Raj Kapoor — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He was married to Krishna Kapoor (married 1946, until 1988).
He is a parent to Rishi Kapoor, Randhir Kapoor, Rajiv Kapoor, Ritu Nanda and Rima Jain.

sections.heading: Raj Kapoor — Net Worth: What Is Actually Verifiable
paras: Net-worth figures for Raj Kapoor circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.
What can be said from the public record is where his income is likely to originate: professional work as a film producer, film director, screenwriter, film editor and film actor.
If a verified figure is published by a credible outlet — a company filing, an election affidavit, or an official disclosure — this section will be updated with the source attached.
